description: Source-backed authoring contract for FOnline prototype files.

scope.support_note: The grammar is documented for a pinned engine revision. Concrete project entity types, properties, file extensions, ids, and gameplay semantics remain project-owned.
included: prototype file discovery and side-specific bake outputs
section forms, prototype identity, inheritance, and migration
property applicability and strict text-value validation
built-in HasProtos entity types and their engine-owned property catalog
excluded: project-authored entity and FixedType declarations or properties
nested map placement sections addressed as $Name/Critter or $Name/Item
gameplay balance, content ids, directory taxonomy, and localization policy
runtime persistence records and project migration rollout policy

file_selection.description: The engine defaults are read from Settings.inc; embedding projects may add extensions without changing the grammar. ProtoBaker consumes every top-level prototype/fixed-type section and skips nested map placements.

section_forms.name: Prototype entity section
section_forms.description: Declares a prototype for a built-in or project-authored entity type whose metadata enables prototypes.

section_forms.name: Fixed type section
section_forms.resolves_to: A metadata type declared with ///@ FixedType
section_forms.description: Declares a prototype-like fixed value defined by embedding-project metadata.

section_forms.name: Map prototype section
section_forms.description: Each top-level ProtoMap anchor declares a Map prototype. Nested $Name/Item and $Name/Critter placement sections are skipped by ProtoBaker and consumed by MapBaker.

directives.name: $Name
directives.default: source file name without its extension
directives.description: Sets the prototype identity within its resolved type. The identity is migration-resolved before duplicate detection.

directives.name: $Parent
directives.description: Lists same-type parent prototypes separated by spaces. Parents are merged left to right and the child is applied last.

rules.name: Configuration syntax
rules.requirement: Use repeated INI-like sections, key = value assignments, # comments, backslash line continuation, and key += value append where appropriate.
rules.description: Prototype files use the shared ConfigFile parser; quoted or escaped comment characters remain part of the value.

rules.name: Extension filter
rules.requirement: Only files whose extension occurs in Baking.ProtoFileExtensions enter ProtoBaker.
rules.description: Directories and conventional extension names do not select a prototype type; the section does.

rules.name: Identity and duplicates
rules.requirement: A migration-resolved prototype id must be unique within its resolved type across the complete pack input.
rules.description: The same text id may exist in different prototype types; duplicate ids in one type fail the bake.

rules.name: Inheritance scope
rules.requirement: Every parent must resolve inside the same prototype type and current pack input.
rules.description: Parents may be declared in another file, but cross-type and missing parents fail the bake.

rules.name: Inheritance precedence
rules.requirement: Merge ancestors depth first, then parents from left to right, then the child; later property values replace earlier values.
rules.description: $-prefixed control directives are not copied into the merged property map.

rules.name: Acyclic inheritance
rules.requirement: Prototype parent graphs must be acyclic.
rules.description: The current baker expands parents recursively and has no dedicated cycle diagnostic; validate this in project tooling and keep chains shallow.

rules.name: Property resolution
rules.requirement: Every non-control key must resolve to a property available for the current bake side.
rules.description: Unknown, disabled-for-this-side, virtual, and temporary properties are rejected; opposite-side-only properties are skipped for that side.

rules.name: Strict text values
rules.requirement: Property values must parse according to the metadata type without overflow, unknown enum/prototype references, non-finite numbers, or malformed collection structure.
rules.description: The property serializer is the authority for scalar, enum, struct, array, dictionary, RefType, FixedType, and Proto reference text.

rules.name: InitScript callback signatures
rules.requirement: A non-empty built-in Item, Critter, Map, or Location InitScript property must resolve to a global void callback receiving that entity type and bool firstTime.
rules.description: Server baking validates ScriptFuncType metadata for every authored callback property and rejects missing functions or mismatched signatures before runtime.

anchors: Script function signature does not match property binding

rules.name: Prototype references
rules.requirement: FixedType and Proto entity property references must resolve after migration unless the property is nullable and the authored value is empty.
rules.description: A removed or renamed referenced id needs an explicit Proto migration rule to a valid target or Remove according to the owning persistence policy.

rules.name: Prototype migration
rules.requirement: Proto migration rules are applied to declared ids, parent ids, lookups, and persisted references before final resolution.
rules.description: Author migrations in native/project metadata with ///@ MigrationRule Proto <Type> <Old> <NewOrRemove>.

rules.name: Side-specific output
rules.requirement: The same source set is parsed and serialized separately for server, client, and mapper metadata.
rules.description: A source property can be meaningful on one side and skipped on another; server output also validates script callback properties.
